The '''GH Maintenance Droid''' was a type of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]]. It was egg-shaped that moved via a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] system. It had two standard grasping arms, along with six interchangeable [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] that could be configured for specific maintenance tasks. The droids had audio and visual [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and a built-in [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that allowed them to stay in contact with a central [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. [[Eyar Treatment Systems]] used the model as its standard model for general sewer system maintenance and upkeep.<ref name="HS" />
